headline: 愛情小說家聊約會文化
context: 英國專欄作家安妮·勞德（Annie Lord）以約會經驗寫成的回憶錄和 Vogue 專欄打響名號，如今推出首部小說，講兩位二十多歲好友在酒吧感嘆交友軟體時代的荒謬。同一週，吉爾福德的莎劇雙聯演《愛的徒勞》與《無事生非》把兩齣十六世紀喜劇串成一個故事，評論讚賞導演的巧思。融合靈魂樂與 shoegaze 的歌手凱拉（Kelela）也發行新專輯，並談到黑人女性創作者面對的處境。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Her breakup memoir and Vogue column made her the voice of modern dating. As her debut is published, she talks about single life, oversharing and why she still believes she’ll find love There is a scene in Annie Lord’s novel that will be instantly familiar to any young person who has spent time at a pub or nightclub recently. Daisy and Maya, two best friends in their mid-20s, are lamenting the paltry state of the dating market. “It’s just shit out there,” Daisy says. “Every time we go out there’s, like, one decent single guy and then about 40 gorgeous women with master’s degrees and shag haircuts and what’s even the point in trying.” Continue reading...
sources.title: ‘People treat each other as disposable’: dating columnist turned novelist Annie Lord on love and sex in the age of apps

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Braboeuf Manor, Guildford Elegantly stitching the plays into two parts of the same continuing story, Tom Littler’s sunny al fresco productions play every possible tragicomic note Two Shakespearean comedies dated to the last decade of the 16th century each seem to lack something. Love’s Labour’s Lost (c 1595) feels in need of a sequel, ending abruptly, with the usual climactic marriages suddenly deferred to the future. Much Ado About Nothing (c 1598) could use a prequel: there is clearly a tantalising backstory to the harsh sparring between Beatrice and Benedick. By double-billing the plays, director Tom Littler explores the scholarly hypothesis (well advanced by HR Woudhuysen) that they may be, in Hollywood terms, parts 1 and 2. Some believe that a Shakespeare play, Love’s Labour’s Won, listed in documents but now missing, may have been Much Ado, which contains a possible Shakespeare in-joke about things seeming clearer “when you have seen the sequel.” Continue reading...
sources.title: Love’s Labour’s Lost / Much Ado About Nothing review – breezy double bill brings out the best in both

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: The genre-bending R&B artist’s new album finds fresh focus for her uncompromising vision, blending soul, sex and shoegaze More than most musicians on a typical promo cycle, Kelela has been appearing on my social feeds in increasingly surreal combinations. In one clip , she blows kisses to an enormous crowd of onlookers on the streets of Soho New York; another sees her posing for fans against a fog-strewn background somewhere between South Central and survivalist video game Silent Hill. In the video for idea 1 the singer saunters down a corridor with windswept silver hair, looking like Storm if the X-Men movies had been directed by Hype Williams. In a widely circulated tribute/parody, the track is synced uncannily well to a cut of RuPaul in the 90s strutting her stuff to the song’s throbbing guitar, while sporting a remarkably similar sleek, platinum blonde wig. “If there were a fan competition amongst artists, I feel like I would win,” the actual Kelela tells me when we meet at a recording studio in east Williamsburg, New York. “No shade to nobody! thread_text:
英國專欄作家安妮·勞德（Annie Lord）靠著約會回憶錄和 Vogue 專欄，成了這一代人談感情的代言人，如今她推出首部小說，寫兩位二十多歲好友在酒吧感嘆交友軟體時代「每次出門，好對象都被搶光」的荒謬。劇場那邊，吉爾福德的雙聯演出把莎士比亞的《愛的徒勞》與《無事生非》串成一個延續故事，評論說每個悲喜交織的瞬間都被導演拿捏得恰到好處。樂壇則有歌手凱拉（Kelela）發行新專輯，融合靈魂樂、性感與 shoegaze 的迷幻聲響，她也談到身為黑人女性創作者，如何在龐雜聲量中找到自己的位置。

本則整理自 The Guardian 於 2026 年 7 月 12 日發佈的報導。
threads_text:
文化這邊三則，剛好橫跨書、劇場和音樂。英國專欄作家安妮·勞德（Annie Lord）靠著一本約會回憶錄和 Vogue 的專欄，成了這一代人談感情狀態的代言人。她的首部小說寫兩位二十多歲的好友在酒吧感嘆交友軟體時代的荒謬——「每次出門，好對象都被搶光了」。劇場那邊，薩里郡吉爾福德的一場戶外雙聯演出，把莎士比亞的兩齣十六世紀喜劇《愛的徒勞》與《無事生非》串成一個延續的故事，評論形容導演把每個悲喜交織的瞬間都拿捏得恰到好處。樂壇則有歌手凱拉（Kelela）發行新專輯，融合靈魂樂、性感與 shoegaze 的迷幻聲響，她也談到身為黑人女性創作者，如何在龐雜的聲量與粉絲文化中，持續替加薩發聲。

本則整理自 The Guardian 於 2026 年 7 月 12 日發佈的報導。
voice_text: 英國有位專欄作家，靠寫約會回憶錄紅了，現在她出了第一本小說。安妮·勞德，原本在 Vogue 寫專欄，這次寫的是兩個二十多歲的好朋友，在酒吧感嘆交友軟體時代有多荒謬——好對象都被搶光了。劇場這邊，吉爾福德有一場戶外雙聯演出，把莎士比亞的兩齣喜劇串成一個延續的故事，評論說每個悲喜交織的瞬間都抓得很準。樂壇則有歌手凱拉發新專輯，融合靈魂樂和迷幻的聲響，她也聊到身為黑人女性創作者，怎麼在龐大的聲量裡，持續替加薩發聲。
